parameters.name: AlertConfig.EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time when the alert takes effect.

Unit: hours (h). Valid values: 0 to 23. For example, a value of 22 indicates 22:00:00.

> If the alert is not within the effective period, alert notifications are not sent even if the threshold is exceeded.

parameters.name: AlertConfig.NotifyType
parameters.description:
The alert notification type. Valid values:

<props="china">- 2: phone call + text message + email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- 1: text message + email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- 0: email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>


<props="intl">0: email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="partner">0: email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

parameters.name: AlertConfig.SilenceTime
parameters.description: The mute period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (1 day).

parameters.name: AlertConfig.StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time when the alert takes effect.

Unit: hours (h). Valid values: 0 to 23. For example, a value of 0 indicates 00:00:00.

> If the alert is not within the effective period, alert notifications are not sent even if the threshold is exceeded.

parameters.name: AlertConfig.WebHook
parameters.description: The webhook address.

parameters.name: AlertConfigEscalationList
parameters.description: The alert configuration list.

sub_parameters.name: Aggregate
sub_parameters.description:
The statistical method for the alert. Valid values of N: 1 to 21. The statistical method varies by metric:

- HttpStatus: Value.
- HttpLatency: Average.
- TelnetStatus: Value.
- TelnetLatency: Average.
- PingLostRate: Average.

> The statistical method for status codes is the original value (Value). The statistical method for latency or packet loss rate is the average value (Average).

sub_parameters.name: MetricName
sub_parameters.description:
The metric for the alert. Valid values of N: 1 to 21. Valid values:

- HttpStatus: HTTP status code.
- HttpLatency: HTTP latency.
- TelnetStatus: TELNET status code.
- TelnetLatency: TELNET latency.
- PingLostRate: PING packet loss rate.

sub_parameters.name: Operator
sub_parameters.description:
The comparison operator for the alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 21. Valid values:

- `>`
- `>=`
- `<`
- `<=`
- `=`

sub_parameters.name: Times
sub_parameters.description: The number of alert retries. Valid values of N: 1 to 21.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The alert threshold. Valid values of N: 1 to 21.

parameters.name: AlertConfigTargetList
parameters.description: The alert trigger targets.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The application group ID.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The availability monitoring task ID.

parameters.name: InstanceList
parameters.description:
The list of ECS instances that initiate detection. Valid values of N: 1 to 21.

> If `TaskScope` is set to `GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE`, you must set this parameter.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description: The name of the availability monitoring task.

parameters.name: TaskOption.HttpHeader
parameters.description:
The header of the HTTP request. Format: `Parameter:Value`. Separate multiple parameters with carriage returns. Example:
```
params1:value1
params2:value2
```

parameters.name: TaskOption.HttpMethod
parameters.description:
The method of the detection type. Valid values:

- GET
- POST
- HEAD

> If the detection task type is HTTP, you must set this parameter. For information about how to set the detection task type, see [CreateHostAvailability](~~115317~~).

parameters.name: TaskOption.HttpNegative
parameters.description:
The alert rule for matching HTTP response content. Valid values:
- true: An alert is triggered if the HTTP response content contains the specified alert rule.
- false: An alert is triggered if the HTTP response content does not contain the specified alert rule.

> If the detection task type is HTTP, you must set this parameter. For information about how to set the detection task type, see [CreateHostAvailability](~~115317~~).

parameters.name: TaskOption.HttpPostContent
parameters.description: The POST content of the HTTP detection request.

parameters.name: TaskOption.HttpResponseCharset
parameters.description:
The response character set for the HTTP detection type.

> Only UTF-8 is supported.

parameters.name: TaskOption.HttpResponseMatchContent
parameters.description: The POST content of the HTTP detection response.

parameters.name: TaskOption.HttpURI
parameters.description: The URI for HTTP or Telnet detection types.

parameters.name: TaskOption.Interval
parameters.description:
The detection frequency. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 15, 30, 60, 120, 300, 900, 1800, and 3600.

> Only CloudMonitor agent 3.5.1 or later supports this parameter.

parameters.name: TaskOption.TelnetOrPingHost
parameters.description:
The domain name or address to detect.

> If the detection task type is PING, you must set this parameter. For information about how to set the detection task type, see [CreateHostAvailability](~~115317~~).

parameters.name: TaskScope
parameters.description:
The detection scope of the availability monitoring task. Valid values:

- GROUP: uses all ECS instances in the current application group as detection probes.
- GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE: uses specified ECS instances in the current application group as detection probes. If you set this parameter to GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE, you must also set InstanceList to specify the ECS instances that initiate detection.
